UpdateLog.description:
<title>New Features</title><font>Tiny</font> - Added ability for modders to define research prerequisites for upgrades.
<title>Additional Changes</title><font>Tiny</font> - Removed Vanilla Outposts Expanded from incompatible list. While the compatibility issue still exists, the two mods can coexist and marking them incompatible was causing too much confusion. You can run them together, but avoid travelling to outposts with vehicles.
<title>Bug Fixes</title><font>Tiny</font> - Fixed animals and mechs not being carried to vehicles when designated for loading. - Fixed pathfinding crash from stale requests remaining tracked by the pathfinder. - Fixed turret min range not drawing its red outline on the map. - Fixed vehicle icons not drawing through vehicle icon drawer in ResearchTab, Designator Groups, etc. - Fixed incorrect fuel tank check when assigning a job for refueling a vehicle with target fuel level less than 100%. - Fixed debug labels not handling translations correctly.
<title>Final Notes</title><font>Tiny</font> There have been many changes since the 1.6 release, so some vehicle mods may need to be updated with Vehicle-Framework 1.7 in order to work.
Please report any issues you find on either <link>https://discord.gg/zXDyfWQ</link>(discord) or <link>https://github.com/SmashPhil/Vehicle-Framework/issues</link>(github).
